scenes.description: One day, the little rabbit heard a tiny bird crying near a river
The bird had fallen from its nest and couldn't fly
The little rabbit wanted to help, but the river was deep and dangerous
The little rabbit quickly called her forest friends
A clever monkey brought a long branch, and a strong elephant carefully lifted the bird
Together, they saved the little bird
The bird happily flew back to its mother
All the animals praised the little rabbit for her kindness
The little rabbit smiled
